Texts in two recensions; one shorter, the other longer.
--(I) Shorter. nearly identical with the first one third part of the fourth adhyāya of the longer. (Beg. atha haiMnaM paiGgalaH papraccha yAjJavalkyaM jJAninAM varam …)
